# Mow Pro Lawn Care LLC (Mow Pro GA)

Locally owned, family-run lawn care company serving Douglasville, GA and
the surrounding area. No contracts — cancel anytime.

## Contact
- Phone: (404) 669-6945
- Email: mowproga@gmail.com
- Website: https://mowproga.com
- Quote form: https://mowproga.com/ (click "Get My Free Instant Quote")

## Service area
Douglasville, GA and Douglas County, including Villa Rica, Lithia Springs,
and Powder Springs.

## Services & pricing (starting prices — Joseph confirms the exact price
## once he sees the property in person)

### Biweekly lawn mowing & edging (mowing, edging, weed eating, debris blow-off)
- Small yard (under 5,000 sq ft): $50
- Medium yard (5,000-10,000 sq ft): $60
- Large yard (10,000-20,000 sq ft): $80
- Extra large / acreage (over 20,000 sq ft): custom quote

### First-cut / overgrown fee
If the lawn hasn't been cut in a few weeks, the price doubles the normal
cut price for that yard size (e.g. a medium yard's normal $60 cut becomes
$120). That covers the first 2 hours on-site; $45/hr for each additional
hour. Grass over 12 inches tall needs a custom, in-person quote.

### Edge restoration (grass grown over a sidewalk or driveway edge)
- Sidewalk only: from $50
- Sidewalk plus one side of the driveway: around $75
- Sidewalk plus both driveway sides, or heavy creep: $100-150
- Long driveways or corner lots: about $1 per linear foot
Confirmed on-site. Routine edging is included with every biweekly mowing
visit — this fee is only for restoring grass that has already grown over
the edge.

### Sidewalk & driveway crack weed spraying
$15

### Leaf removal (separate service from mowing)
- Small yard: $90+
- Medium yard: $150+
- Large yard: $225+
- Extra large / acreage: custom quote
Default service is blowing leaves off the lawn, beds, and hard surfaces
into a pile at the wood line or a spot the customer chooses. Bagging and
hauling leaves away is an optional add-on, $5-8 per bag depending on
volume. Heavy tree coverage needs a custom, in-person quote.

### Fall yard cleanup (seasonal bundle — see /fall-cleanup)
Leaf removal plus a final fall mow & edge and flower bed/border cleanout,
with driveways and walkways blown off clean. Priced the same as leaf
removal above, by yard size.
